text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a schoolwide competitive eating contest 
held by student volunteers, I spotted 
Oguri Cap among the contestants.
choice_data_list: Wait, Oguri! You'll gain weight again!

Wait, Oguri! You're going to gain weight 
again!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop me, Trainer...! I absolutely 
have to win this battle.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“For the victor's honor— and the 
mega-portion ramen voucher...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Oguri Cap's resolve is firm. If 
so, all I can say right now is...
choice_data_list: Go out there and fight your heart out!

Go out there and fight with everything 
you've got!

I'd like you to pace yourself in 
moderation.
Eat and eat... devour it all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Oguri Cap's resolve is firm. If 
so, all I can say right now is...
choice_data_list: Go out there and fight your heart out!

Go out there and fight with everything 
you've got!

I'd like you to pace yourself in 
moderation.
Eat and eat... devour it all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Keep your eyes on me, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I will win without fail, and get my hands 
on that mega-portion ramen voucher...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap exuded a magnificent fighting 
spirit. It was reminiscent of how she 
looked during a race.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Oguri Cap!! 
Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer...! The prize is mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smile Oguri Cap gave as she said that 
was brighter than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—And the victory goes to both Oguri Cap 
and Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a tie with Spe, was it? I hope we can 
both receive prizes, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Oguri Cap's slightly frustrated 
expression, I knew I had to plan a routine 
to burn off the weight she had undoubtedly 
gained.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"However, this is an eating contest. It's 
tough to pace yourself while aiming for 
first place..."
choice_data_list: If it's ramen, it's on me.
If it's ramen, I'll treat you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Understood... I'll try to make it work.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Special Week!! 
Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I lost, huh... But well, Trainer is 
treating me to ramen either way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under Oguri Cap's intense gaze, I resolved 
to search for a restaurant serving healthy 
ramen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Does that mean leaving nothing 
behind, finishing every single dish 
prepared?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If so, I'm sure the people who made 
it will be happy. Understood. I'll do my 
best.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, our next dish is the Mt. 
Fuji-sized mountain of fried chicken! With 
such a heavy menu hitting at mid-game, 
even our proudest big eaters are dropping 
out one after another~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
N-No moooore~...! I can't eat another 
bite...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright. In that case, I'll take 
whatever's left.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wh-Why?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... All right. Looks like there's 
nothing left. Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
A-And it's decided! For some reason, Oguri 
Cap even cleared the other contestants' 
dishes, taking the victory in a league 
entirely of her own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The ultimate form of victory, one no one 
could ever match. Oguri Cap achieved it— 
...at the cost of consuming a monumental 
number of calories."
